description.text: The primary mission is to lead a team that ensures semiconductor designs meet TSMC’s stringent reliability standards before they are manufactured. This involves managing the deployment and optimization of PERC (Programmable Electrical Rule Checking) flows to detect complex electrical failures like Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) and Latch-up
